summary: All 17 files in the RSW (Russo-Seymour-Welsh) theory directory contain substantive formal mathematical content: definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs related to percolation crossing events, self-duality, renormalization, exponential decay upgrades, strip crossing gluing, and P4/P5 equivalences. None are pure import aggregators, documentation-only, or build scripts. Every file contributes unique formal mathematics to the corpus.
